artifact: Mermaid Roshan V29 independent language audit
scope: All 32 story-page captions, two cover treatments, visual-language agreement and shared-reading suitability for ages 4–5. Read-only baseline review followed by this evidence record.
count_note: Caption count only. Covers and separate speech-balloon text are excluded. Contractions count as one token.
strengths: Brief captions and uncluttered syntactic units.
Concrete actions with problem, help and relief.
Repeated help phrase and participatory sound words.
Playful dust bunnies remain welcome and learn gentle play.
Rumi's long residence is distinct from her current entrapment.
Grand Puff receives reassurance and collaborative cleaning.
A vivid rainbow metaphor and inclusive sleep ending.

highest_priority.finding: The cup has no introduction, location or unmistakable visible removal.
Gentle-play guidance is clearer as an explicit invitation after the apology.
Several captions compete with dark or mottled full-art textures.
Essential clearing action is currently carried chiefly by words.

page_recommendations.current_text:
“Look, Daddy!
Pearl Castle!”
page_recommendations.recommended_text:
“Look, Daddy!
Pearl Castle!”
page_recommendations.reason: Short quotation invites participation and establishes the castle. Check contrast against the window.

page_recommendations.current_text:
Roshan and Daddy landed at Sky Lagoon.
Pearl Castle was close by.
page_recommendations.recommended_text:
Roshan and Daddy landed at Sky Lagoon.
Pearl Castle was close by.
page_recommendations.reason: Names and setting are clearly introduced and supported by the picture.

page_recommendations.current_text:
“Let’s look inside,
Daddy,” said Roshan.
page_recommendations.recommended_text:
“Let’s look inside,
Daddy,” said Roshan.
page_recommendations.reason: Intention, speaker and entry action align.

page_recommendations.current_text:
Inside, dust covered the floor.
“Let’s clean it together!”
page_recommendations.recommended_text:
Inside, dust covered the floor.
“Let’s clean it together!” said Roshan.
page_recommendations.reason: Name the speaker who initiates the helping goal. Current text competes with dark architecture.

page_recommendations.current_text:
Daddy gave her a brush and a sponge.
“One little job at a time.”
page_recommendations.recommended_text:
Daddy gave her a brush and a sponge.
“One little job at a time.”
page_recommendations.reason: Two concrete tool names and the one-job-at-a-time phrase provide useful structure.

page_recommendations.current_text:
A dust bunny splashed in the dirty bath.
It loved to play. Splash, splash!
page_recommendations.recommended_text:
A dust bunny splashed in the dirty bath.
It loved to play. Splash, splash!
page_recommendations.reason: The playful dust bunny is introduced without blame. Preserve the Splash, splash! refrain; improve contrast over the mottled floor.

page_recommendations.current_text:
Round and round went the sponge.
Roshan wiped the sink clean.
page_recommendations.recommended_text:
Round and round went the sponge.
Roshan wiped the sink clean.
page_recommendations.reason: Circular action and clean result are concrete. The sponge must visibly contact the sink.

page_recommendations.current_text:
Roshan let the dirty bath water out.
Then she scrubbed the tub. Scrub, scrub!
page_recommendations.recommended_text:
Roshan let the dirty bath water out.
Then she scrubbed the tub. Scrub, scrub!
page_recommendations.reason: Then makes the sequence explicit. Preserve the Scrub, scrub! refrain.

page_recommendations.current_text:
Clean water filled the bath.
The dust bunny splashed again!
page_recommendations.recommended_text:
Clean water filled the bath.
The dust bunny splashed again!
page_recommendations.reason: The clean bath payoff keeps the dust bunny welcome. No additional discovery instruction is needed.

page_recommendations.current_text:
A mermaid named Rumi was stuck
under the gunk in the pool.
page_recommendations.recommended_text:
A mermaid named Rumi was stuck
under the gunk in the pool.
page_recommendations.reason: Rumi is named, identified as a mermaid and given a clear immediate problem.

page_recommendations.current_text:
This castle had been Rumi’s home
for hundreds of years.
“I’ll help!” said Roshan. Scoop, scoop!
page_recommendations.recommended_text:
Rumi had lived in Pearl Castle
for hundreds of years.
“I’ll help!” said Roshan. Scoop, scoop!
page_recommendations.reason: Name the castle directly and keep long residence distinct from the recent entrapment.

page_recommendations.current_text:
One stream ran clear.
Roshan cleared the next... and the next.
page_recommendations.recommended_text:
One stream ran clear.
Roshan cleared the next... and the next.
page_recommendations.reason: Words describe a clearing action that the current picture does not adequately demonstrate. Show at least one genuinely cleared stream.

page_recommendations.current_text:
All three streams were clear.
Whoosh! The waterfall turned rainbow!
page_recommendations.recommended_text:
All three streams were clear.
Whoosh! The waterfall turned rainbow!
page_recommendations.reason: Counting and rainbow payoff are strong; improve caption contrast against water.

page_recommendations.current_text: Roshan pulled the cup free!
page_recommendations.recommended_text:
A cup was stuck in the seahorse fountain.
Roshan pulled it free!
page_recommendations.reason: Introduce the cup and its location before resolving it. The current empty-handed image also needs action clarity.

page_recommendations.current_text:
Fresh water flowed. The gunk was gone.
Up came Rumi. She was free!
page_recommendations.recommended_text:
Fresh water flowed. The gunk was gone.
Up came Rumi. She was free!
page_recommendations.reason: Cause and result are clearly stated. Preserve the brief joyful reveal and improve legibility.

page_recommendations.current_text:
“You helped me!”
said Rumi.
She gave Roshan
a great big hug.
page_recommendations.recommended_text:
“You helped me!”
said Rumi.
She gave Roshan
a great big hug.
page_recommendations.reason: Short gratitude dialogue and the hug create a satisfying emotional pause.

page_recommendations.current_text:
Chirp, chirp!
“Someone needs help!” said Roshan.
page_recommendations.recommended_text:
Chirp, chirp!
“Someone needs help!” said Roshan.
page_recommendations.reason: The chirp provides a gentle prediction before the Eagle reveal. Ensure text is distinct from the floor.

page_recommendations.current_text:
Two dust bunnies had tumbled onto Baby Eagle.
They wanted to play, but he was stuck.
page_recommendations.recommended_text:
Two dust bunnies had tumbled onto Baby Eagle.
They wanted to play, but he was stuck.
page_recommendations.reason: Intention and unintended consequence are explicit. Exactly two trapping bunnies must be clear in the picture.

page_recommendations.current_text:
“I’ll help!” said Roshan.
She brushed one bunny away, then the other.
page_recommendations.recommended_text:
“I’ll help!” said Roshan.
She gently brushed one bunny away, then the other.
page_recommendations.reason: Gently reinforces care and clarifies that the brush is not a punishment. Keep physical contact away from Eagle's face.

page_recommendations.current_text:
Baby Eagle was free!
Now they could play gently.
page_recommendations.recommended_text:
Baby Eagle was free!
“Let’s play gently,” said Roshan.
page_recommendations.reason: The explicit model of gentle play makes the social resolution clearer than Now they could play gently. Preserve both owner-specified apology balloons.

page_recommendations.current_text:
Brushes here. Paints there.
Roshan put each thing in its place.
page_recommendations.recommended_text:
Brushes here. Paints there.
Roshan put each thing in its place.
page_recommendations.reason: Sorting uses concrete categories and here/there language. Do not add a disconnected craft-making task.

page_recommendations.current_text:
Scrub, scrub! The table was clean.
Everything was back in its place.
page_recommendations.recommended_text:
Scrub, scrub! The table was clean.
Everything was back in its place.
page_recommendations.reason: Quick cleanup payoff gives the art room a meaningful role without delaying the larger story.

page_recommendations.current_text:
One last door began to glow.
A rumble came from behind it...
page_recommendations.recommended_text:
One last door began to glow.
A rumble came from behind it...
page_recommendations.reason: Last and behind are useful relational words. The rumble prepares the reveal.

page_recommendations.current_text:
Grand Puff!
He was so dusty.
He did not feel well.
page_recommendations.recommended_text:
Grand Puff!
He was so dusty.
He did not feel well.
page_recommendations.reason: Dust and discomfort establish empathy for Puff rather than blame.

page_recommendations.current_text:
“Hold on, we’ll make you feel
clean and better!” said Roshan.
page_recommendations.recommended_text:
“Hold on, we’ll make you feel
clean and better!” said Roshan.
page_recommendations.reason: Preserve the owner's exact reassurance. Supply, gesture and expression should make care visible.

page_recommendations.current_text:
Daddy, Rumi, and Baby Eagle helped Roshan.
Together, they washed Grand Puff. Scrub, scrub!
page_recommendations.recommended_text:
Daddy, Rumi, and Baby Eagle helped Roshan.
Together, they washed Grand Puff. Scrub, scrub!
page_recommendations.reason: Names identify the helpers and Together confirms collaboration. The caption needs quiet high-contrast space.

page_recommendations.current_text:
Soft bubbles covered Grand Puff.
Under the bubbles, his colors began to shine.
page_recommendations.recommended_text:
Soft bubbles covered Grand Puff.
Under the bubbles, his colors began to shine.
page_recommendations.reason: Concealment prepares the next-page surprise and the continuing character remains clear.

page_recommendations.current_text:
POP! Grand Puff sprang out, rainbow bright!
The dust fell away.
page_recommendations.recommended_text:
POP! Grand Puff sprang out, rainbow bright!
The dust fell away.
page_recommendations.reason: Sprang is suitable picture-supported vocabulary. Preserve energetic sound and punctuation.

page_recommendations.current_text:
Down came Grand Puff, soft and small.
He felt like himself again.
page_recommendations.recommended_text:
Down came Grand Puff, soft and small.
He felt like himself again.
page_recommendations.reason: Down echoes earlier Up; size change is concrete and emotional recovery is clear. Improve contrast.

page_recommendations.current_text:
“Your rainbow was there all along,
Grand Puff. We helped it shine!”
page_recommendations.recommended_text:
“Your rainbow was there all along,
Grand Puff. We helped it shine!”
page_recommendations.reason: The rainbow metaphor is the emotional statement and is immediately supported by visible colors. Preserve its warmth.

page_recommendations.current_text:
“Come and play, Baby Eagle!”
The little dust bunnies played gently, too.
page_recommendations.recommended_text:
“Come and play, Baby Eagle!”
The little dust bunnies played gently, too.
page_recommendations.reason: Successful gentle play resolves the earlier accident and provides a bridge into rest. Art should feel quieter than the rescue.

page_recommendations.current_text:
There was room for everyone.
They curled up in the bubbles and fell asleep.
page_recommendations.recommended_text:
There was room for everyone.
They curled up in the bubbles and fell asleep.
page_recommendations.reason: Inclusive and restful close. The text needs a quiet area within the full art.

cover_recommendations.reason: Title invites interest and is paid off by the rainbow reveal.
Retain the approved image and keep development guidance outside the story.

Do not add search instructions or clues for hidden background visitors.

operational_age_4_5_rubric.pass_check: Each story event has an identifiable character/action/result in the words, pictures or their combination. An adult can retell why the help was needed and what changed without supplying missing plot.
operational_age_4_5_rubric.current_evidence: 32-page draft read in order; cup introduction, Rumi residence and gentle-play invitation revised.

operational_age_4_5_rubric.pass_check: Every quotation has a clear pictured speaker or attribution. Pronouns have a nearby unambiguous referent; the two dust bunnies, Rumi and continuing Puff identity remain clear.
operational_age_4_5_rubric.current_evidence: Roshan attribution on4 is now intentionally three lines; said Roshan remains together. Quotes and speaker references are clear.

operational_age_4_5_rubric.pass_check: New or figurative words are supported by a concrete image, action or meaningful phrase. Retain varied words when their meaning is supported; do not impose an invented age-based word limit.
operational_age_4_5_rubric.current_evidence: Scoop, scrub, gunk, stream, rumble and sprang have action/context support. The rainbow metaphor follows the visible transformation.

operational_age_4_5_rubric.pass_check: Sentences are grammatical and natural aloud. Sequence markers and contrasts make causes and outcomes understandable. Lines preserve complete phrases and do not strand a speaker name.
operational_age_4_5_rubric.current_evidence: The required phrase-preserving attribution fix on4 is visible. Sentence and sequence wording read naturally.

operational_age_4_5_rubric.pass_check: Refrains occur naturally in their action context and can be echoed voluntarily; there is no requirement to answer a quiz or decode the whole story. Read aloud without awkward breath or punctuation breaks.
operational_age_4_5_rubric.current_evidence: I’ll help!, Splash, splash!, Scoop, scoop! and Scrub, scrub! retained.

operational_age_4_5_rubric.pass_check: Pictures and words distinguish playful intention from accidental harm, show apology and gentle-play guidance, and present Puff cleaning as cooperative care. No punitive brush action or attack language remains.
operational_age_4_5_rubric.current_evidence: Native rescue18/19 show exactly two puffs trapping/releasing Eagle’s wings and the brush touching a puff. Owner-exact reassurance remains on25; all helpers wash Puff on26.

operational_age_4_5_rubric.pass_check: Story captions and dialogue use native Sniglet at least18pt at7×5in trim, with1.3× leading; no glyph is clipped. Meaningful line units, quiet space and visually readable contrast must pass final page inspection.
operational_age_4_5_rubric.current_evidence: All34 pages inspected. Native story text is embedded Sniglet18–20pt and boxes are inside trim. p3/6/10 retain targeted contrast-review notes.

operational_age_4_5_rubric.pass_check: Objects and actions named by the caption are visibly identifiable. Essential mechanics do not rely on adult explanation. Decorative performances do not change or contradict the main event.
operational_age_4_5_rubric.current_evidence: Pink cup is visible in Roshan’s hands beside the flowing fountain in14. Clearing progresses from one clear lane/two green lanes to rainbow payoff. Rescue18/19 show the two-puff release.

operational_age_4_5_rubric.pass_check: Problem/action/payoff units are understandable; reveals are not prematurely explained. Background details remain secondary to text/faces/action. The play-to-nap close is gentle.
operational_age_4_5_rubric.current_evidence: Bathroom6–9, pool10–16, rescue17–20, craft21–22 and Puff23–30 form linked help episodes;31–32 close with play and rest.

operational_age_4_5_rubric.pass_check: Record exact revised PDF identity, an actual named SLP review when obtained, print proof and owner/child feedback separately from machine geometry and editorial review.
operational_age_4_5_rubric.current_evidence: No SLP review, physical print proof or child observation has been supplied.

operational_rubric_note: These are explicit project editorial checks informed by official guidance. They are not clinical screening criteria, developmental norms, or a certified numeric master-audit score.

Brush is against a puff, not Eagle’s face.
